name: Spots
description: A tiny log of places: photo, position, note. A custom app on the phone's features.

why.data: Keep your spots on this phone
why.haptics: A tap you feel when a spot is saved
why.widget: Keep the Home Screen widget up to date

schema: CREATE TABLE spots (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT (lower(hex(randomblob(8)))), name TEXT NOT NULL, lat REAL, lon REAL, photo TEXT, thumb TEXT, created TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')))

card.query: SELECT count(*) AS spots FROM spots
